name: assessments_timeline
description: A person's lifecycle history on one assessment, oldest first, from their event stream: assignment to the framework and removal from it, cycle joins, exits and conclusions, every alignment started, completed and re-opened (per role, with role_id, role_code, role_name and home — whether it was the role they held when they joined the cycle), role, level and reporting-manager changes, explorations started and closed, and manager-rating delegations granted and revoked — each with occurred_at (ISO 8601 UTC) and the actor. Unlike assessments_get and reporting_cycle_cohort, which keep only the latest stamp, this answers when an alignment was first completed and how often it was re-opened. Self and manager assessment completion have no event: they appear with derived: true, at their latest completion only. Pass cycle_id for one cycle's milestones, and kinds to narrow by kind (an empty list returns none). Free-text reasons appear only for the manager chain and tenant admins. Returns no rating values.

cycle_id.description: Keep only the milestones of this cycle (from reporting_cycles_list or assessments_get).

kinds.description: Keep only these kinds of milestone.
